records.jp: ……こんなことになってしまって、ごめんなさい
records.en_original: ...I'm sorry that all of this happened.
records.en_auxiliary: ...I'm sorry that all of this happened.
records.en: ...I'm sorry that all of this happened.

records.jp: ……いや、詩さんのせいじゃないよ
records.en_original: It's not your fault, Uta.
records.en_auxiliary: It's not your fault, Uta.
records.en: It's not your fault, Uta-san.

records.jp: もともと、危険かもしれないって分かってたし、<CR>それでも行こうって決めたのは私だから
records.en_original: We knew that it was dangerous to begin with, and I'm the one who made the decision to go.
records.en_auxiliary: We knew that it was dangerous to begin with, and I'm the one who made the decision to go.
records.en: We knew that it was dangerous to begin with,<CR>and I'm the one who made the decision to go.

records.jp: 星崎さんは、優しいです
records.en_original: You're very kind, Ao.
records.en_auxiliary: You're very kind, Ao.
records.en: You're very kind, Hoshizaki-san.

records.jp: ……そうかな
records.en_original: ...You think?
records.en_auxiliary: ...You think?
records.en: ...You think?

records.jp: そうです。みなさんも優しいです
records.en_original: Yes. Everyone here is.
records.en_auxiliary: Yes. Everyone here is.
records.en: Yes. Everyone here is.

records.jp: 私は……優しさに甘えてしまいました
records.en_original: I've...relied on that kindness.
records.en_auxiliary: I've...relied on that kindness.
records.en: I... took advantage of your kindness.

records.jp: 全部は思い出せていませんが……<CR>私が危険な人間だということは分かりました
records.en_original: While I don't remember everything...I do know that I was a very dangerous person.
records.en_auxiliary: While I don't remember everything...I do know that I was a very dangerous person.
records.en: I have not remembered everything...<CR>but I understand that I was a dangerous person.

records.jp: 私は、ここにいるべきじゃない……。<CR>こんなに優しくされるような人間じゃないんです
records.en_original: I have no place here. I don't deserve the kindness that I've been shown.
records.en_auxiliary: I have no place here. I don't deserve the kindness that I've been shown.
records.en: I should not be here...<CR>I am not someone who deserves such kindness.

records.jp: ……私もさ。<CR>なんでここにいるんだろうって思うこと、あるんだ
records.en_original: You know, I've also wondered about what why I'm here.
records.en_auxiliary: You know, I've also wondered about what why I'm here.
records.en: ...I also<CR>sometimes wonder why I am here.

records.jp: みんなの役に立ててるかわからないし……
records.en_original: I don't even know if I've been much help at all to everybody...
records.en_auxiliary: I don't even know if I've been much help at all to everybody...
records.en: I don't even know if I've been much help at all to everybody...

records.jp: 今回も、こんなことになっちゃって、<CR>せっかく任せられたリーダーの役目も果たせてない
records.en_original: And I really messed up things this time, even after they made me the leader.
records.en_auxiliary: And I really messed up things this time, even after they made me the leader.
records.en: And this time, after being entrusted with<CR>the role of leader, I still failed to fulfill it.

records.jp: ずっと悩んで……迷ってた
records.en_original: I've thought about it a lot, looking for an answer...
records.en_auxiliary: I've thought about it a lot, looking for an answer...
records.en: I kept worrying... and wavering.

records.jp: ……何か、答えは出たのですか？
records.en_original: Did you one?
records.en_auxiliary: Did you one?
records.en: ...Did you find an answer?

records.jp: いいや、ぜーんぜん。<CR>ていうか、余計に分かんなくなった
records.en_original: Nope, not at all. Honestly, I'm just more confused than ever.
records.en_auxiliary: Nope, not at all. Honestly, I'm just more confused than ever.
records.en: No, not at all.<CR>If anything, I understand even less now.

records.jp: そう、ですよね……
records.en_original: Ah... I see...
records.en_auxiliary: Ah... I see...
records.en: Yes... I suppose so.

records.jp: でも、答えが出なくても、<CR>何かを決断しないといけない時は勝手に来る
records.en_original: But even if I don't have a clear answer, there may be a time I have to make a decision.
records.en_auxiliary: But even if I don't have a clear answer, there may be a time I have to make a decision.
records.en: But even without an answer,<CR>the moment when we must decide something arrives on its own.

records.jp: 今回みたいにね
records.en_original: Just like what happened recently.
records.en_auxiliary: Just like what happened recently.
records.en: Just like this time.

records.jp: そう、ですね……
records.en_original: Yes...
records.en_auxiliary: Yes...
records.en: Yes...

records.jp: 私は、すごいと思います
records.en_original: I think you're quite amazing.
records.en_auxiliary: I think you're quite amazing.
records.en: I think you are remarkable.

records.jp: 星崎さんは……こんな不思議な世界でも、<CR>自分を強く持っている
records.en_original: You've never lost sight of yourself, despite finding yourself in a strange, new world.
records.en_auxiliary: You've never lost sight of yourself, despite finding yourself in a strange, new world.
records.en: Hoshizaki-san... Even in this strange world,<CR>you hold firmly to who you are.

records.jp: そ、そうかなぁ？　そんなことないと思うけど……
records.en_original: Y-you really think so? I'm not so sure about that...
records.en_auxiliary: Y-you really think so? I'm not so sure about that...
records.en: Y-you really think so? I'm not so sure about that...

records.jp: 私は、どうなりたいのか、何が正解なのか、<CR>明確な目的地すら見つかっていません
records.en_original: I still have no idea who I am, what I want to be, or where I want to go.
records.en_auxiliary: I still have no idea who I am, what I want to be, or where I want to go.
records.en: I do not know what I want to become, what is right,<CR>or even have a clear destination.

records.jp: でも、星崎さんは違う
records.en_original: You are different from me, Ao.
records.en_auxiliary: You are different from me, Ao.
records.en: You are different from me, Hoshizaki-san.

records.jp: 仮に……今は力不足だとしても、<CR>みんなに頼られるリーダーになる、という目標がある
records.en_original: Even if you are lacking strength like you say, the goal of becoming a reliable leader is admirable.
records.en_auxiliary: Even if you are lacking strength like you say, the goal of becoming a reliable leader is admirable.
records.en: Even if... you lack the strength now,<CR>you have the goal of becoming a leader everyone can rely on.

records.jp: 目指しているものが明確であることは、<CR>自分を強く持っていると言いかえられると思います
records.en_original: I think the fact that you have a goal at all means that you have a better understanding of yourself.
records.en_auxiliary: I think the fact that you have a goal at all means that you have a better understanding of yourself.
records.en: Having a clear goal can also be<CR>described as holding firmly to yourself.

records.jp: 少し、羨ましいです
records.en_original: I'm a little jealous.
records.en_auxiliary: I'm a little jealous.
records.en: I'm a little jealous.

records.jp: ……詩さんにそんなこと言われるとは。<CR>ちょっとびっくりした
records.en_original: ...I'm a little surprised hearing you say that.
records.en_auxiliary: ...I'm a little surprised hearing you say that.
records.en: ...I am a little surprised to hear you<CR>say that, Uta-san.

records.jp: そ、そうですか……？　ごめんなさい……
records.en_original: R-really? I'm sorry...
records.en_auxiliary: R-really? I'm sorry...
records.en: I-is that so...? I am sorry...

records.jp: ああいや、そういう意味じゃなくて！
records.en_original: No, I didn't mean it like that!
records.en_auxiliary: No, I didn't mean it like that!
records.en: No, I didn't mean it like that!

records.jp: ……ありがとう。なんか、<CR>ちょっとだけ自信ついたかも
records.en_original: ...I wanted to say thank you. I feel a little better now.
records.en_auxiliary: ...I wanted to say thank you. I feel a little better now.
records.en: ...Thank you.<CR>I may have gained a little confidence.
